clips.title: The story
paras: Argent Guard Manados is a night elf sentry stationed in Darnassus on behalf of the Argent Dawn. Resting at the Craftsmen's Terrace, he keeps watch over Kalimdor's growing corruption and directs adventurers toward the sinister forces lurking in Blackfathom Deeps.

While most of the Argent Dawn focuses its vigilance on the blighted lands of Lordaeron and the Scourge, Argent Guard Manados represents their watchful eyes in the night elf capital of Darnassus. Standing among the artisans and tradefolk of the Craftsmen's Terrace, Manados monitors emerging threats that menace the balance of northern Kalimdor. When rumors reach him of the Twilight's Hammer cult establishing a foul foothold beneath the waves of Ashenvale, Manados enlists capable heroes to strike at Blackfathom Deeps and recover artifacts of their dark devotion.
